notes.title: Patch - June 20th, 2025
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Thanks for the early feedback. We have fixed some bugs which were annoying and needed to go.

Fixes:

-Graphical issue where some area of certain buildings were flickering.
-Fixed objects which appeared to be floating.
-Fixed one AI which was behaving not as intended.
-Updated Shadow options which provides more detailed shadows
-Few other minor fixes.

Thank you for playing Wiped Clean. Hope you will have lots of fun :)

notes.content:
[h3][i]Wiped Clean[/i] is finally available to play! — and we couldn’t have done it without YOU.[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]From the bottom of our hearts, [b]THANK YOU[/b] for every wishlist, every comment, every bit of hype and encouragement along the way. notes.title: What are we working on?
notes.content:
Hey Cleaners! 

We know it’s been some time since our last update, but trust us—we’ve been cooking up something EPIC behind the scenes!  We are working non-stop to bring you a massive upgrade packed with new features, scares, and secrets that’ll make your washing hand tremble. Buckle up, because here’s what’s new...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453172/ba9860d2d1edec16b2564ad6c5343fa1f98d9589.png[/img]

Say goodbye to the old look—Wiped Clean is getting a visual glow-up! Based on your feedback and our playtesting, we’re shifting toward realistic graphics that’ll make every bloodstain, shadow, and creepy corner feel way more immersive. The grime has never looked this good… or this terrifying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453172/ae8216a58b26281b2fa6f21d8d1dd13a121175c7.png[/img]

Cleaning up blood is just the start of your nightmare. New terrifying events are lurking in the shadows, ready to mess with your sanity. One wrong move and—BOOM—you might just regret turning off the lights. Keep your wits about you, Cleaner… the job just got deadly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453172/f0f1476a9b1acfd6ec8b5273131c9c9116007453.png[/img]

Wiped Clean isn’t just a cleaning sim—it’s a mystery waiting to be unraveled. Dive deep into a  storyline full of shocking reveals, hidden agendas, and mind-blowing twists that’ll leave you questioning everything. How deep does the truth go? That’s for you to find out…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453172/99bf997e03a09dd81a74e0af057efadfe501f946.png[/img]

Every character you meet has secrets—some darker than others. 🖤 Their backstories unfold based on how much you explore, what evidence you uncover, and even the choices you make. Will you dig deep enough to learn the truth? Or will some mysteries stay buried forever?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453172/e8abd1c10e0025733ebd7474ae4bf60e272ba9e8.png[/img]

The AIs in Wiped Clean just got a major upgrade. 🧠 They react to your movements, remember your actions, and won’t make it easy for you. Smarter enemies, unpredictable behaviors—good luck outsmarting them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453172/849c22e1fc42c7a2678d872485edfed247662ede.png[/img]

No more clunky movements! Based on your feedback, we’ve completely revamped the controls to make every swipe, sprint, and stealth move buttery smooth. Now you can focus on surviving… instead of fighting the controls.

STAY VIGILANT, CLEANERS. THIS IS JUST THE BEGINNING. 

We can’t wait for you to experience everything we’ve been building. The shadows are growing darker… and the bloodstains aren’t cleaning themselves.

Thank you for your unreal support—now get ready. Things are about to get messy. 

🔜 Coming Soon…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453172/396da60bdc8ad0bb131d2a63190ec5d8844c5ccd.png[/img]

notes.title: HUGE SUCCESS OF WIPED CLEAN AT STEAM NEXT FEST!
notes.content:
Cleaners, we’re beyond thrilled to announce that Wiped Clean crushed it at Steam Next Fest! The response was incredible, far exceeding our expectations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453172/37b9a9f47c3be9c0d8fd4323f7275d1fc3da67c4.png[/img]

The game gained huge traction, bringing in thousands of new wishlists on Steam! This tells us one thing—people are hungry for more, and we’re ready to deliver. If you haven’t wishlisted yet, now’s the time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453172/2421209fa726376c0f4ff7ad44b1f2cd76941889.png[/img]

From dedicated VR fans to first-time players, Wiped Clean was played by a huge number of people during the festival. Seeing so many players experience the eerie, intense cleanup process was a surreal moment for us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453172/1f73e829d4fe3428e64711a49893940c42d6347c.png[/img]

It was incredible to see top VR creators dive into Wiped Clean! A Wolf in VR, one of the biggest names in VR gaming, played the game and really enjoyed the experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453172/898824cffce1d1f8aaa4a237f52ce1ffb13d9ae5.png[/img]

The community’s feedback on the demo has been invaluable. We’ve analyzed everything—what you loved, what could be better, and what features would make Wiped Clean even more immersive. We’re already planning big updates based on this feedback, and you’ll hear more about them soon!

This is just the beginning. We’re expanding the game, adding new surprises, refining the gameplay, and making sure Wiped Clean delivers an even [b]more intense and thrilling experience at Launch.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453172/396da60bdc8ad0bb131d2a63190ec5d8844c5ccd.png[/img]
